stem: The thickness of books in a large library is normally distributed with mean 2.4 cm and standard deviation 0.3 cm.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find the probability that the total thickness of 6 randomly chosen books is more than 16 cm.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Find the probability that the thickness of a book chosen at random is less than 1.1 times the thickness of a second book chosen at random.
